newsitem.title: EGYPT: New Egyptian bourse chief wants more disclosure.
newsitem.headline: New Egyptian bourse chief wants more disclosure.

text.p: The newly appointed chairman of the Egyptian stock exchange said on Monday his priorities would be making information available to small investors and solving problems with the exchange's computers.

"The small investor is of special interest to me. Mutual funds and big operators can obtain information. The ordinary public should be able to take its decisions wisely so the information has to be clear and easy to understand without recourse to an accountant," Abdelghani Gamie told reporters.
Listed companies have an obligation to release quarterly results within one month of the end of the period but very few of them have been doing this regularly.
Foreign investors have also complained about the failure of companies to comply with the disclosure requirement.
The exchange's computerised dealing, clearing and central depositary systems has had serious teething problems over the months but brokers say the situation is gradually improving.
